news.text: I joined Ofcom as an Academic Fellow.
I received a Global Scholars Fund for a Manchester–Melbourne collaboration on trustworthy AI, misinformation-driven opinion dynamics and digital governance.
Our study of disruption risks at maritime chokepoints was published in the European Journal of Operational Research.
I was one of four finalists for the EURO Doctoral Dissertation Award and presented my thesis work at IFORS 2026 in Vienna.
We are guest editing a special issue in the Information Processing & Management 'Explainable AI and Network Science for Social Systems and Collective Intelligence'.
